attribution.legal_posture: CoinDesk investigative reporting supports a historical employment-persona and incident relationship. It supplies no verified civil or legal identity, nationality, criminal charge, conviction, sanctions designation, present location, current activity, or control of any payment address.

caveats: CoinDesk independently reports Jun Kai as an Iqlusion developer and states that blockchain review found nearly $8 million sent to addresses tied to OFAC-designated Kim Sang Man. The evidence supports a research-attributed persona and payment-linkage finding; legal identity requires a separate source.

One investigative publisher family supports this persona. Payment linkage or incident co-occurrence provides contextual association; verified natural person or present controller status requires a source bridge.
Only the CoinDesk-supported persona and relationship claims are admitted; upstream-only account, image, residence, contact, identity-document, and payment-address material is excluded.
